pavasati.cp: pa + vas + a. dwells abroad; is away from home.
pavasati.p: [ pa + vasa + a + ti ] (kri) Google Translate (1) He entered and stayed. (2) He went to another place.

C: pavasati：[pa + vas + a] dwells abroad； is away from home．
P: Pavasati，[pa+vas] to “live forth，” i．e．to be away from home，to dwell abroad Sn．899； J．II，123 （=pavasaṁ gacchati）； V，91．-- pp．pavuttha （q．v．）．Cp．vi°．（Page 443）
R:
pavasati：ပ-ဝသတိ （ပ√ဝသ်）
အရပ်တစ်ပါးသို့ သွား၍ နေ၏။ ကွေကွင်း၍ နေ၏။ ဤအရပ်မှ ကင်း၏။
DOP: pavasati pr. 3 sg. [ S. pravasati], goes abroad, is away from home; Ja II 123, 15* (na santi devā ~anti nūna; 123, 21´ : kiccesu uppannesu nūna ~anti pavāsaṃ gacchanti); — part.pr. ( a ) pavasa(t), mfn. , S I 37, 7* (sattho ~ato mittaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee pathavato; Se pasavato); Sn 899 (patthayatīdha suddhiṃ satthā va hīno ~aṃ gharamhā; Pj II 558, 19 : [gharamhā] ~anto satthato hīno yathā taṃ gharaṃ satthaṃ vā pattheyyā ti); ( b ) pavasanta, mfn. , Pj II 558, 19 ; — pp pavuttha , mfn. [ cf S. proṣita], 1. who is away from home, is abroad; Ja IV 198, 4* (~aṃ c’ assa sarati āgataṃ abhinandati, Ce, Se so; Be ~aṃ tassa; Ee ~aṃ taṃ taṃ; 198, 24´ : ~an ti videsagataṃ); V 23, 21* (Pañcālarājā migavaṃ ~o, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se paviṭṭho; 23, 25´ : migavadhatthāya raṭṭhā nikkhanto); 434, 11 (sāmikassa pavāsaṃ vaṇṇeti ~aṃ na sarati); — ifc see cira-; — ~-patikā, ( m ) f ( n ). [pavuttha + pati 2 + kā 2 ], whose husband is away from home; Vin III 83, 24 (itthi ~patikā jārena gabbhinī hoti); Mil 205, 15 ; Vibh-a 339, 20 (vidhavā vuccanti matapatikā vā ~-patikā vā); — 2. gone away; effaced; D II 261, 10* (~-jātim akhilaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ anāsavaṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pavuṭṭha-; Sv 692, 12 : ~ā vigatā jāti assā ti ariyasaṅgho ~-jāti nāma, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pavuṭṭhā … pavuṭṭha-; Sv-pṭ II 308, 6 foll.: ~ā ti pavāsaṃ gatā viya apetā … ~ā vā pakārato vutthā vusitā, tena jāti vusitabbā assā ti ~-jāti); — caus. pp pavāsita, mfn. , 1. sent abroad; Ap 559, 3 (na rocesi pati mayhaṃ, tadā tamhi pavāsite ekikā niggatā gehā); — 2. sent; ? Ja V 377, 7* (Kāsiyo haṃsānaṃ abhihāresuṃ aggarañño pavāsitaṃ, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se aggaṃ rañño; 377, 13´ : haṃsarañño paṇṇākāratthāya Kāsirañño pesitaṃ nānaggarasabhojanaṃ).

pavāsa.p: [ pa + vasa + ṇa ] (pu) Google Translate (1) distance from the ring; Traveling to a distant place. (2) (a) Son and wife - in a place far away from his own place. (b) By not returning again, to a distant place. (Ti) (3) Those who are separated by going far away - to other places - he.

P: Pavāsa，[fr．pa+vas，cp．Vedic pravāsa in same meaning] sojourning abroad，being away from home J．II，123； V，434； VI，150； Miln．314．-- Cp．vi°．（Page 444）
